column1: # one row per leftover seed of the count-free fit
column2: nearest_tile = fitted tile whose seed sheet is closest (dist_sheet_mm)
column3: tile_u/v/h_mm = position in that tile's bent-tile frame (h > 0 toward the cavity)
column4: layer_class: sheet / stacked / edge / far (see layer_rows)
column5: dist_*_mm unsigned distance to the wall mesh / Cav_Post mesh
column6: blob_* from detection (split_k > 1 = from a k-means split of a merged blob, n_fragments > 1 = rejoined fragments)
column7: peak_hu_1mm = max HU within 1 mm of the centre on the raw volume
